pages.text:
SUBPOENA DUCES TECUM
UNITED STATES OF AMERICA — DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY
INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE
TO:  Cascade Timber Holdings, Attn: Legal Department, Portland, OR
DATE ISSUED:  May 23, 2023
RESPONSE DUE:  On or before June 13, 2023 (21 days)
YOU ARE HEREBY COMMANDED to produce the books, papers, records, and other data described
below relating to the Coastal Solar Credit Program:
Document Requests
1. All marketing materials related to the Coastal Solar Credit Program, including but not limited to
broker network materials distributed in 2022 and 2023.
2. All investor communications regarding the Coastal Solar Credit Program.
3. All records, communications, and agreements between Cascade Timber Holdings, Alder Point
Partners, and any brokers engaged in connection with the Coastal Solar Credit Program, including
Bellhaven Advisory.
4. All records concerning land parcel conservation eligibility determinations made in connection with
Coastal Solar credit applications.
Certification
Failure to comply with this subpoena may result in enforcement proceedings in the United States
District Court.
/s/ Revenue Agent — Internal Revenue Service, Examination Division

pages.text:
LITIGATION HOLD NOTICE
CASCADE TIMBER HOLDINGS — LEGAL DEPARTMENT
TO:  All Cascade Timber Holdings Staff
FROM:  John Ellery, Head of Legal
DATE:  June 13, 2023
RE:  Litigation Hold — Coastal Solar Credit Program
This is a formal legal hold notice. Cascade Timber Holdings has received a subpoena from the Internal
Revenue Service concerning the Coastal Solar Credit Program.
You are required to preserve all documents, communications, and records — in any format, including
email, drafts, calendar invites, text messages, and hard-copy documents — relating to: (1) the Coastal
Solar Credit Program; (2) Alder Point Partners; and (3) Bellhaven Advisory.
Do not delete, modify, or otherwise dispose of any potentially relevant materials pending further notice
from Legal. This obligation applies even to materials you might otherwise delete or overwrite in the
ordinary course of business.
Direct any questions to Legal before taking any action that could affect potentially relevant materials.

paragraphs.text: UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY — INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE
SMALL BUSINESS / SELF-EMPLOYED DIVISION — EXAMINATION
OFFICE OF FIELD EXAMINATION, PACIFIC NORTHWEST AREA — PORTLAND, OREGON POST OF DUTY
In the matter of:
CASCADE TIMBER HOLDINGS, INC.
(Coastal Solar Credit Program)
IRS Case No. EX-2023-04471   ·   TIN on File: XX-XXX4471   ·   Examination Group 1476
SUMMONS
TO:  Cascade Timber Holdings, Inc., Attn: Legal Department
1200 Forest Park Way, Suite 900, Portland, OR 97209
DATE ISSUED
RESPONSE DUE
June 13, 2023 (21 days)
PLACE OF PRODUCTION
IRS Field Office, 1220 SW 3rd Ave, Portland, OR 97204, Room 408

YOU ARE HEREBY SUMMONED AND REQUIRED, pursuant to 26 U.S.C. § 7602 and applicable Treasury Regulations, to appear before Revenue Agent Kevin Tran, or his designee, and to produce for examination and copying the books, papers, records, and other data described below, in connection with the Internal Revenue Service's civil examination of the business venture known as the "Coastal Solar Credit Program," developed, marketed, financed, and administered in whole or in part by Cascade Timber Holdings, Inc. and its affiliates.
Definitions
“Program” means the Coastal Solar Credit Program, including any predecessor or successor offerings marketed under substantially similar terms.
“Affiliate” means any entity under common control with, controlled by, or controlling Cascade Timber Holdings, Inc., including Alder Point Partners and its subsidiaries.
“Records” means documents in any form, including electronically stored information, whether created, received, or maintained by or on behalf of the recipient.
Document Requests

1.  Records regarding tax-credit transactions involving renewable energy and land conservation programs, including credit origination, eligibility determinations, appraisal reports, and transaction structuring documents for calendar years 2021 through 2023.

2.  Marketing and sales materials for the Coastal Solar Credit Program, including broker network materials, investor-facing decks, private placement memoranda, subscription agreements, and sales communications distributed in 2022 and 2023.

3.  Records reflecting relationships with investors, buyers, sellers, land trusts, and advisors in connection with the Program, including engagement letters, correspondence, fee agreements, and due-diligence files.

4.  Records concerning corporate entities affiliated with Alder Point Partners, including organizational documents, capitalization tables, ownership records, and inter-company agreements, together with any records concerning brokers engaged in connection with the Program, including Bellhaven Advisory.

5.  Tax, accounting, banking, and loan records connected to the Program, including general ledger entries, bank statements, loan agreements, wire transfer confirmations, and tax filings (including Forms 8283 and 3468) referencing Coastal Solar credit transactions.

6.  Board minutes, internal memoranda, and compliance files discussing the tax treatment, valuation methodology, or regulatory risk of the Program, including any communications with outside counsel or tax opinion providers not subject to a valid claim of privilege.

7.  A privilege log identifying, by document, any responsive record withheld on grounds of attorney-client privilege or work-product protection, in a form sufficient to permit the Service to evaluate the claim.
Manner of Production

Records may be produced in native electronic format with accompanying metadata, or as legible photocopies organized and labeled to correspond with the categories set forth above. Electronic production should be provided on encrypted media or via the Service's secure file-transfer portal, with a cover letter identifying the custodian(s) and date range for each category produced.
Certification

Failure to comply with this summons may result in enforcement proceedings in the United States District Court for the District of Oregon pursuant to 26 U.S.C. §§ 7402(b) and 7604(a), and may further result in referral for consideration of penalties under applicable law.
Kevin Tran
Kevin Tran, Revenue Agent
Internal Revenue Service, Examination Division
Badge No. 74-1129   ·   (503) 555-0148   ·   kevin.tran@irs.gov
